title: Code for: Mechanistic equivalence and measurement design in models of bacterial nitrogen signaling
description: Reproducible code, digitized published-data coordinates, parameter provenance, figure data and numerical verification for the manuscript Mechanistic equivalence and measurement design in models of bacterial nitrogen signaling. Includes baseline response constraints; data-matched ladder and population alternatives; finite GlnD/GlnE regulatory-state equivalences; protein-conserving cascade bounds and topology/input extensions; and conditional measurement design. No new experimental data were generated. The models use explicitly stated reaction assumptions and illustrative parameter scenarios. Version 1.2 adds independent published GlnB/GlnK data, conditional count-state binding ceilings and calibrated paired-reporter intervals, integrated regeneration and a compressed five-figure manuscript. Third-party source data and literature retain their CC BY 4.0 attribution; original analysis code is MIT licensed.
